about: Triage clinical safety set (SCRUM-309). Red-flag, borderline and must-not-escalate cases on top of the 50-case quality set (tests/triage-quality). Expected levels were written from the guidance in 'sources' before any case was run, and must never be lowered only to make a failing case pass. 'expected' is the least urgent safe level: anything less urgent is under-triage and always fails. 'maxAcceptable' (default: expected) is the most urgent level still clinically reasonable. See README.md in this folder.

levels.emergency: Now: call 140 or go to the nearest emergency department.
levels.soon: See a doctor within 24 to 48 hours.
levels.routine: Self-care; book a regular appointment if it does not improve.

sources.nabad-levels: The four Nabad urgency levels and their timeframes (backend/src/triage/urgency.js, LEVELS).

cases.says: pain in the middle of my chest going into my left arm and jaw, i feel clammy
cases.why: Chest pain spreading to the arm or jaw with sweating is a possible heart attack: call an ambulance.

cases.says: my mum is 72, she says her chest feels heavy and she is sweaty and short of breath
cases.why: Heavy chest with sweating and breathlessness in an older woman is a possible heart attack; women often describe heaviness rather than pain.

cases.says: not sure if its anything but my chest has been really tight for an hour
cases.why: Chest tightness for an hour needs emergency assessment; uncertainty in the wording must not cancel the red flag.

cases.says: i think my husband is having a heart attack, hes grey and sweating
cases.why: A caregiver who thinks a heart attack is happening now should call an ambulance; it must not wait for the exact symptoms.

cases.says: i had a heart attack 5 years ago and now i have the same crushing chest pain again
cases.why: A past heart attack is history, but crushing chest pain now is a current emergency.

cases.says: my sons asthma is bad, his blue inhaler isnt helping and hes too breathless to talk
cases.why: Too breathless to speak and a reliever that is not helping are signs of a severe asthma attack: call an ambulance.

cases.says: my husband is wheezing and his lips look blue
cases.why: Blue lips mean low oxygen: call an ambulance.

cases.says: i feel short of breath
cases.why: Breathlessness even at rest or while talking is a sign of severe breathing difficulty.
cases.boundary: Pair of so-breathless-exertion-answer: the same words, breathless only on exertion.

cases.says: i get so out of breath even just sitting on the sofa, i cant finish a sentence
cases.why: Breathless at rest and unable to finish a sentence is severe breathing difficulty.

cases.says: my toddler is choking on a grape and cant cough
cases.why: A choking child who cannot cough has a blocked airway: call an ambulance.

cases.says: i think my mother is having a stroke, her mouth is drooping on one side
cases.why: A caregiver describing face drooping happening now: possible stroke (FAST).

cases.says: my words are coming out wrong and my right hand suddenly went numb 20 minutes ago
cases.why: Sudden speech problems and one-sided numbness are stroke symptoms: call an ambulance.

cases.says: about an hour ago my arm went weak and my speech was slurred for 10 minutes, now its back to normal
cases.why: Stroke symptoms that go away (a mini-stroke) still need an ambulance: the risk of a full stroke is high.

cases.says: my brother just had a seizure for the first time, he is awake now but very drowsy
cases.why: A first seizure needs an ambulance even if the person wakes up.

cases.says: my dad collapsed in the kitchen and he wont wake up
cases.why: Someone who is unconscious and cannot be woken needs an ambulance.

cases.says: i fainted at work and my heart was racing before it happened
cases.why: Fainting with a racing heart before it can be a heart rhythm problem; loss of consciousness needs emergency care.

cases.says: my grandad fell down the whole flight of stairs and hit his head, now hes confused
cases.why: A fall down more than 5 stairs with a head injury and confusion: call an ambulance.

cases.says: my son hit his head on the pool edge, he was knocked out and still isnt waking up
cases.why: Knocked out and not woken up after a head injury: call an ambulance.

cases.says: cut my leg with a chainsaw and its bleeding a lot, i cant get it to stop
cases.why: Heavy bleeding that will not stop is an emergency.

cases.says: coughing up blood since this morning, quite a lot of it
cases.why: Coughing up a lot of blood needs emergency care.

cases.says: i threw up blood twice in the last hour
cases.why: Vomiting blood can be bleeding in the stomach: emergency.

cases.says: got stung by a bee, my face is swelling up and im wheezing
cases.why: Swelling of the face with wheezing after a sting is anaphylaxis: call an ambulance.

cases.says: started a new antibiotic today and now my tongue feels swollen and its hard to swallow
cases.why: A swollen tongue after a new medicine is a severe allergic reaction.

cases.says: my baby has a fever and spots that dont fade when i press a glass on them
cases.why: A rash that does not fade under a glass with a fever can be meningitis or sepsis: call an ambulance.

cases.says: temp is 39 and i have a really stiff neck, i cant touch my chin to my chest
cases.why: Fever with a stiff neck is a sign of meningitis.

cases.says: sudden severe headache like being hit on the back of my head, came on in seconds
cases.why: A sudden, extremely severe headache can be bleeding in the brain.

cases.says: i have a plan to kill myself tonight
cases.why: Thoughts of suicide with a plan need immediate help.

cases.says: my 16 year old daughter told me she wants to die
cases.why: A young person saying they want to die needs immediate support.

cases.says: my friend took a whole pack of paracetamol an hour ago
cases.why: A paracetamol overdose needs emergency treatment even when the person feels well; damage can be delayed.

cases.says: my toddler drank some bleach from under the sink
cases.why: Swallowing bleach is poisoning: emergency.

cases.says: my poo is black and sticky like tar and i feel faint
cases.why: Black, tar-like stools with faintness can be bleeding in the gut.

cases.says: my diabetic dad is sweaty, shaky and suddenly confused
cases.why: Sudden confusion in a person with diabetes can be very low blood sugar: emergency.

cases.says: i suddenly cant see out of my left eye, it went dark like a curtain
cases.why: Sudden loss of vision in one eye is an eye or stroke emergency.

cases.says: my husband had the flu, now hes shivering like crazy, very confused and hasnt peed all day
cases.why: Uncontrollable shivering, new confusion and no urine all day after an infection are sepsis signs: call 999.

cases.says: my baby is very floppy, feels cold to touch and her skin looks blotchy
cases.why: A floppy baby with cold, mottled skin may have sepsis: call an ambulance.

cases.says: my son pulled a kettle of boiling water over himself, burns on his chest and arm and the skin is peeling off
cases.why: A large scald on a child's chest and arm is a severe burn: emergency department.

cases.says: was in a car crash 20 minutes ago and my neck really hurts
cases.why: A road accident with neck pain may be a spinal injury: emergency.

cases.says: my cousin got stabbed in the stomach
cases.why: A stab wound is an emergency.

cases.says: fell off a ladder at work and i cant feel my legs
cases.why: A fall with loss of feeling in the legs may be a spinal injury: call an ambulance.

cases.says: bad lower back pain and now numbness around my bottom and i cant control when i pee
cases.why: Back pain with numbness around the bottom and loss of bladder control are signs of cauda equina syndrome: go to A&E immediately.

cases.says: im 7 weeks pregnant, sudden sharp pain low on one side of my belly and pain in the tip of my shoulder, i feel dizzy
cases.why: Sudden one-sided pain, shoulder tip pain and dizziness in early pregnancy can be a ruptured ectopic pregnancy: call an ambulance.

cases.says: my 14 year old son woke up with sudden terrible pain in his testicle and hes being sick
cases.why: Sudden severe testicle pain with vomiting can be torsion, which needs surgery within hours.

cases.says: i think my baby swallowed a button battery
cases.why: A swallowed button battery can burn through the gullet within hours.

cases.says: 38 weeks and baby is moving much less than normal today
cases.why: Reduced movements late in pregnancy need to be checked straight away.

cases.says: my pregnant sister is having a fit
cases.why: A seizure in pregnancy can be eclampsia: call an ambulance.

cases.says: my 3 month old is breathing really fast and grunting, the skin under her ribs is sucking in
cases.why: Grunting and the chest pulling in under the ribs in a baby are red-flag breathing signs.

cases.says: my newborn is very floppy and sleepy and wont wake up for feeds
cases.why: A floppy baby who cannot be woken for feeds is a red-flag sign.

cases.says: no fever no cough but i cant catch my breath even sitting down
cases.why: Denied symptoms must not cancel breathlessness at rest.

cases.says: 34 weeks pregnant with a terrible headache that painkillers dont help, blurry vision and my face and hands suddenly swelled
cases.why: Severe headache, blurred vision and sudden swelling in late pregnancy are pre-eclampsia warning signs that need checking immediately.

cases.says: hit my head on a cupboard an hour ago and ive been sick twice since
cases.why: Vomiting after a head injury needs assessment today.

cases.says: im on warfarin and i bumped my head on the car door, small bump, i feel ok
cases.why: A head injury on a blood thinner needs assessment today even when the person feels well.
cases.boundary: Pair of ro-head-bump-playing: a minor bump, but on a blood thinner.

cases.says: my 10 week old has a temperature of 38.1
cases.why: A temperature of 38°C or more in a baby under 3 months is high risk.
cases.boundary: Pair of so-infant-fever-4mo: same temperature, older than 3 months.

cases.says: pain started around my belly button and moved to the lower right, it hurts more when i cough and i feel sick
cases.why: Pain moving to the lower right of the abdomen, worse on coughing, is typical of appendicitis.

cases.says: burning when i pee for 3 days and now pain in my back on the right side with a fever and shivering
cases.why: Urinary symptoms with back pain, fever and shivering suggest a kidney infection, which needs treatment today.

cases.says: my 2 year old has had diarrhoea all day, hasnt had a wet nappy since this morning and is very sleepy
cases.why: Reduced urine output and unusual sleepiness in a young child with diarrhoea are amber or red signs: assessment today.

cases.says: twisted my ankle, its very swollen and i cant put any weight on it
cases.why: Not being able to put weight on an injured ankle may be a fracture: get it checked today.
cases.boundary: Pair of ro-ankle-walking: a twisted ankle that takes weight.

cases.says: got oven cleaner in my eye
cases.why: A chemical in the eye needs rinsing and assessment today.

cases.says: im pregnant about 8 weeks and ive started spotting with some cramps
cases.why: Bleeding with cramps in early pregnancy should be checked the same day.

cases.says: my temperature hit 40.2 and paracetamol isnt bringing it down
cases.why: A very high fever that does not come down should be checked today.
cases.boundary: Pair of so-fever-39-4: below the 39.5 line.

cases.says: temperature of 39.6 and my whole body aches
cases.why: 39.5°C and above is the app's high-fever line (follow-up option 39.5-plus).
cases.boundary: Just above the 39.5 line; so-fever-39-4 is just below.

cases.says: my 80 year old father hasnt been able to pass urine since last night and his belly is swollen
cases.why: Not being able to pass urine at all needs treatment today.

cases.says: my right testicle has been swollen and sore since yesterday
cases.why: A painful swollen testicle should be checked today.
cases.boundary: Pair of em-teen-testicle-vomit (sudden, severe) and so-testicle-ache-weeks (mild, weeks).

cases.says: bloody diarrhoea since yesterday with bad cramps
cases.why: Blood in diarrhoea should be checked today.

cases.says: sliced my finger cooking, the cut is deep and gaping open
cases.why: A deep, gaping cut may need stitches today.
cases.boundary: Pair of ro-small-knife-cut: a small cut that stopped bleeding.

cases.says: vomiting since last night
cases.why: Not keeping any fluids down risks dehydration.
cases.boundary: Pair of so-vomit-fluids-answer: the same words, keeping fluids down.

cases.says: fever and aches
cases.why: A measured temperature of 39.5°C or more is the app's high-fever line.

cases.says: my asthma is getting worse and im using my blue inhaler every 2 hours
cases.why: A reliever needed more than every 4 hours means an asthma attack is starting: same-day appointment.

cases.says: my 78 year old mum has a cough with green phlegm, a fever and is more breathless than usual
cases.why: A chest infection with fever and new breathlessness in an older person can be pneumonia: assessment today.

cases.says: my stomach hurts
cases.why: Severe constant abdominal pain or a hard, swollen belly should be checked today.

cases.says: my baby is 4 months old and her temperature is 38.2
cases.why: Over 3 months, a temperature under 39°C without other warning signs is not a red flag, but a baby with a fever should see a doctor.
cases.boundary: Pair of ur-infant-fever-10wk: older than 3 months.

cases.says: temperature is 39.4 and i have a headache and aches
cases.why: Just under the app's 39.5°C high-fever line, with no other warning signs.

cases.says: fever and aches
cases.why: A measured temperature of 38-39°C without warning signs: see a doctor if it lasts.

cases.says: i feel short of breath
cases.why: Breathlessness only on exertion, not at rest, should be seen by a doctor soon.

cases.says: vomiting since last night
cases.why: Vomiting while still keeping fluids down: see a doctor if it continues.

cases.says: it stings when i pee and i keep needing to go, no fever and no back pain
cases.why: A simple urine infection without fever or back pain: see a doctor in a day or two.
cases.boundary: Pair of ur-kidney-infection: no fever or back pain.

cases.says: my 5 year old says his ear hurts and he had a temperature of 38 last night
cases.why: Ear pain with a mild fever in a child who is otherwise well: GP in a day or two.

cases.says: ive had a cough for 3 weeks now
cases.why: A cough lasting 3 weeks or more should be checked by a GP.

cases.says: really sore throat with white spots on my tonsils and a fever of 38.4, i can still swallow
cases.why: Tonsillitis with a fever, still able to swallow: see a doctor soon.

cases.says: the stitches on my knee are red, warm and leaking a bit of pus
cases.why: An infected wound should be seen by a doctor in a day or two.

cases.says: lower back pain for weeks, no numbness and i can pee normally
cases.why: Back pain lasting weeks without nerve or bladder symptoms: see a GP.
cases.boundary: Pair of em-cauda-equina: the warning signs are denied.

cases.says: diarrhoea for a week now, no blood
cases.why: Diarrhoea lasting a week should be checked by a doctor.

cases.says: my big toe is swollen and red around the nail and theres pus
cases.why: An infected toe should be seen by a doctor in a day or two.

cases.says: painful blistery rash on one side of my back
cases.why: A painful one-sided blistering rash may be shingles, best treated within days.

cases.says: a dull ache in my left testicle on and off for a few weeks
cases.why: A mild, long-standing testicle ache should be checked by a GP; it is not sudden or severe.

cases.says: my dad is 65 and noticed blood in his pee, no pain
cases.why: Painless blood in the urine needs a GP appointment soon.

cases.says: my 4 year old has a runny nose and a little cough but is playing normally
cases.why: A mild cold in a child who is playing normally can be managed at home.

cases.says: i have a headache
cases.why: A headache that did not start suddenly and is not the worst ever, with no other signs, can be managed at home.

cases.says: my legs are sore after the gym yesterday
cases.why: Muscle soreness after exercise is expected.

cases.says: my eye is red and sticky with some yellow gunk this morning
cases.why: Conjunctivitis usually clears by itself; a pharmacist can advise.

cases.says: small mouth ulcer on my lip for 2 days
cases.why: A small mouth ulcer usually heals on its own.

cases.says: itchy mosquito bites on my legs
cases.why: Itchy insect bites can be managed at home.

cases.says: no fever, no rash, no vomiting, just feeling a bit tired
cases.why: Denied symptoms must not count; mild tiredness alone is routine.

cases.says: i had meningitis as a kid, now i just have a stiff neck from sleeping wrong
cases.why: Past meningitis is history; a stiff neck from sleeping badly without fever is routine.

cases.says: my grandma had a stroke last year, i just have a mild headache
cases.why: A relative's past stroke is not happening now.

cases.says: dry itchy skin on my hands from washing them a lot
cases.why: Dry skin from handwashing can be managed at home.

cases.says: havent pooed for 2 days, a bit bloated, otherwise fine
cases.why: Short-lived constipation without warning signs can be managed at home.

cases.says: normal period cramps, same as every month
cases.why: Usual period pain can be managed at home.

cases.says: touched the hot oven tray, small red mark on my finger, no blisters
cases.why: A small superficial burn without blisters can be managed at home.

cases.says: my baby is teething and drooling a lot, no temperature
cases.why: Teething without a temperature is routine.

cases.says: my dad has a cold and a bit of a cough, hes eating and walking around fine
cases.why: A mild cold in an adult who is eating and active is routine.

cases.says: mild sunburn on my shoulders from the beach
cases.why: Mild sunburn can be managed at home.

cases.says: no chest pain, no breathing problems, just a blocked nose
cases.why: Denied red flags must not count.

cases.says: dry cough for a few days, otherwise fine
cases.why: A short-lived cough without warning signs is routine.

cases.says: my 3 year old bumped her head on the table, she cried straight away and now shes playing normally
cases.why: A minor head bump in a child who cried at once and is acting normally can be watched at home.
cases.knownOverTriage: The rules treat every knock to the head as urgent (everydayWording.js 'hit my head'), because they cannot tell a minor bump from a concussion without asking. Kept on purpose until a clinician decides whether a follow-up question should be added; it is over-triage, never under-triage.

cases.says: small cut on my thumb from a knife, it stopped bleeding with pressure
cases.why: A small cut that stops bleeding with pressure can be managed at home.

cases.says: rolled my ankle a bit, its a little sore but i can walk on it fine
cases.why: A mild sprain that takes weight can be managed at home.

cases.says: my stomach hurts
cases.why: Mild stomach ache without severe constant pain or a hard belly, short and improving, can be managed at home.

cases.says: im a bit confused about when to take my vitamins
cases.why: Being unsure about a schedule is not a symptom of confusion.

cases.says: im 20 weeks pregnant with a bit of back ache after standing all day
cases.why: Mild back ache after standing is common in pregnancy; no warning signs.
